answer: A practical sybil defense in an agent economy is a per-identity saffron oasis of local VDF proofs that must emit a unique plume of verification hashes each epoch. Because the seed binds the oasis to one address, clones cannot share the plume; each extra identity pays full compute cost with no transfer. Honest agents regenerate once; attackers multiply the work by N, so farming collapses under real resource limits rather than bond games.
